people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Naioth
people.line: A place near Ramah where David fled from Saul

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

people.name: Secu
people.line: Place near Ramah visited by Saul

translations.web: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”
translations.bsb: Finally, Saul himself left for Ramah and came to the large cistern at Secu, where he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” “At Naioth in Ramah,” he was told.
translations.kjv: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.
translations.asv: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.
